en: Black‑and‑white view of a European spa town set against wooded hills. In the foreground is a long colonnaded building with large windows and a rooftop terrace lined with trees in planters and benches. At its center rises a small circular pavilion with a domed roof supported by columns. To the right stands a tall square tower with an onion‑shaped cupola and open belfry. On the left and in the background are ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses and hotels. German‑language signage is visible on some facades.
